messages:
alex: quick heads-up 17:30 UTC deploy for rwd-gen-2026-04a. Drafting an internal two-line blurb and need ops pin + scheduling check. Thinking canary 5% x15m, then 25% x10m. Rollback on error rate >0.4% or p95 +150ms.

alex: short draft to review:

"Were rolling out execution-layer optimizations to text-gen (batcher tuning + cache heuristics). Typical token cost improves; no API changes. Canary starts 17:30 UTC, ops monitoring active; rollback plan in runbook. Contact @rory for ops."

rory: +1 on content. Suggest moving canary to 10% first window, 15m is fine though. Also @lina, infra runs a network patch at 17:20 UTC 17:40 UTC, possible conflict?

lina: yes patch is scheduled, but it's low-impact. Still prefer shifting to 18:00 UTC to be safe.

tasha: customer comms note: for Dedicated customers we should add a line "no reserved-capacity changes". I'll draft CS blurb.

alex: ok shift to 18:00 UTC. @deploy-bot can you update the queued deploy? Keep windows: canary 10%/15m, staged 25%/10m.

deploy-bot: queued deploy request updated. Command for execution:

```
/deploy rwd-gen-2026-04a --canary=10 --canary-duration=15m --staged=25:10m --owner=@rory --pin=true
```
Awaiting approver.

ops-bot: runbook link: <https://internal.runbooks/releases/rwd-gen-2026-04a>. Added rollback checklist and metric thresholds. Pager if error_rate >0.4% or p95 latency increases by >150ms.

rory: I'll be oncall from 17:4519:00. Setting monitoring alerts and smoke tests. If thresholds hit I'll trigger rollback to tag v3.2.1.

alex: final internal blurb (will post to #staff-digest at 17:45 UTC for quick eyes):

"Deploying text-generation runtime optimizations (batcher + KV cache heuristics). Typical token cost reduction and throughput improvements; no API changes. Canary 18:00 UTC; ops monitoring in place; rollback plan in runbook. Contact @rory for ops."

tasha: :thumbsup: from CS side. I'll add Dedicated note to the customer-facing snippet.

lina: :thumbsup: infra ok with 18:00.

rory: :thumbsup: ready to execute.

alex: locking 18:00 UTC. Approver please react with :white_check_mark: to proceed.

tasha: :white_check_mark:

lina: :white_check_mark:

rory: :white_check_mark:

alex: thanks all 18:00 UTC deploy locked. Posting RN draft to staff and linking the runbook. Will update here if anything changes.
